title: Please review this merge request. This is a merge of 3.4.1 from unstable plus the addition of an upstream patch for hardware acceleration on s390x.
description:
Please review this merge request. This is a merge of 3.4.1 from unstable plus the addition of an upstream patch for hardware acceleration on s390x.

The previous upload had this in the changelog:
+  * d/p/fips/crypto-Automatically-use-the-FIPS-provider-when-the-kerne.patch:
+    Extend the patch to print the error encounted when a fallback
+    provider fails loading, e.g. due to FIPS auto-loading (LP: #2066990)

This was a change to a Ubuntu patch so I've dropped the specific changelog entry but it's still present.

+From: Chris Coulson <chris.coulson@canonical.com>
